notes: Missing node; 0..5 slots; path words 0..12 and 0xfffe (slot size -1); slot kinds 9 and others; CX positive, negative and at the int16 limits. Stubs log their register and stack arguments (narrow ones zero-extended) and pop what the callee pops; 0xb8cf8 flips the kind byte, 0xb5640 bumps the slot size and 0xb570c moves the buffer pointer, so rereads of those fields are checked.
